subject.title: fix(ios): smooth sidebar gestures and toolbar controls

question: After a current-main rebase and motion proof, should the iOS sidebar adopt this centralized gesture and toolbar implementation across root destinations?
rationale: This changes the primary iPhone navigation gesture surface introduced by the recent sidebar redesign; the protected maintainer workflow and remaining motion-proof gap require an owner to accept the interaction tradeoff.

options.title: Rebase and add motion proof
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main and provide a redacted recording or diagnostic UI-test artifact showing slow/reversed edge drags and a pushed-screen native back swipe.

options.title: Pause for sidebar-owner review
options.body: Keep the PR open without merge action until the sidebar feature owner confirms the cross-root gesture contract and toolbar behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase and add motion proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main and provide a redacted recording or diagnostic UI-test artifact showing slow/reversed edge drags and a pushed-screen native back swipe.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged overlay-sidebar redesign whose navigation and gesture contract this patch refines.
